questions.comprehension_passage: Fill in the blanks with correct expressions of numbers/values/quantity. Banned betting sites are piggybacking on popular platforms again, as India’s taxmen and regulators play whack-a-mole with shady operators from distant shores. Betting ads have popped up on grocery app Zepto and on taxis operated by an Uber fleet provider, while items branded 1xBat, a mirror name for betting app 1xBet, sell on Amazon. India has banned and blocked [i] _____ of offshore gambling platforms, but many of them still operate through so-called mirror sites– replicas of the original with a near identical URL, and hosted on a different server. Meanwhile, [ii] _____ celebrities endorse and keep the betting platforms in public view, while tax authorities stare at lost revenue. Everest fleet, Uber’s [iii] _____ cab-provider, said it became aware of the ads recently and takes the matter seriously. In September, Uber had invested [iv] $30 _____ in the company. The Zepto app has displayed ads from Parimatch, a banned betting platform. Amazon displays various sports goods branded 1xBat, a close imitation of 1xBet. Despite the government’s blocking them, Cyprus- based 1xBet and Parimatch and Curacao-based Fairplay remain [v] _____ visible through digital advertising, while escaping the tax payments that local gaming companies are subjected to. Sadashi, Sakshi. “Betting Ads Mushroom in India’s Regulatory Grey Zone.” Mint, Mumbai, vol. 8, no. 91, 15 Apr. 2025, p. 1.

questions.text: Asking about the working hours.
options: Hey there, when are you all open?
Excuse me. Please be accommodating enough to let me know the working hours that your establishment adheres to. I would be greatly obliged if you could do this, and will remain eternally grateful.
If you do not tell me your working hours, I am not coming to this godforsaken place again.
Excuse me, could you please tell me your working hours? And do they change on weekends?
questions.correct_answer: Excuse me, could you please tell me your working hours? And do they change on weekends?

questions.text: Returning a faulty product.
options: Hey, this pan here is horrible. Its handle just broke off before I could use it. Get me a replacement or a refund, now!

Good evening, I have come to return this pan that I bought yesterday. Its handle broke before I could use it. I believe that this product is faulty, and that I am eligible for a replacement or a refund. Would you please take a look at this for me? Here are the bill details.
The handle of this pan broke off. So, I am going to the courts if you don’t give me a replacement or a refund right away. I will break every pan here until I get that.
Pray, help me get a replacement or a refund for this broken pan which I bought from your esteemed store yesterday.

I believe that this product is faulty, and that I am eligible for a replacement or a refund. Would you please take a look at this for me? Here are the bill details.

questions.text: Declining an offer.
options: I’m sick of your special offers, please leave me alone.
I don’t want any special offers. You are all liars. You advertise one thing, and give something else. Don’t play your games with me.
I’m sorry, but I do not want the special offer. While it is very tempting, I do not have space in my apartment to accommodate all these new things. Thank you for letting me know!

I am extremely sorry to decline your offer, but I am afraid I am left with no choice but to do so. I have my hands tied here and I can inform you of this turning down only with a heavy heart that is filled to the brim with regret.
questions.correct_answer: I’m sorry, but I do not want the special offer. While it is very tempting, I do not have space in my apartment to accommodate all these new things. Thank you for letting me know!

questions.text: Informing the manager of spelling mistakes in the name board.
options: If you do not mind, I would like to borrow your valuable time to bring to your notice certain errors that have unfortunately crept into the words on your name board. They are mostly spelling mistakes. I am greatly sorry for this state of affairs.
Your people are either stupid, or they did not sit through language classes. Your name board is full of errors. Get it out!
Throw out your name board man. It has a spelling mistake that a seven year old kid won’t make. Pathetic.

Excuse me, just wanted to let you know that there are a few spelling mistakes that have crept into your name board. It is better if you could change the name board or update it if possible with the correct spelling. That will give it a better impression when someone sees it. Thought I’d share it with you because I am a well-wisher of this shop.

What makes the sentence below a complex sentence? I learned a long time ago that it is a poor plan to overlook any chance.
options: The presence of the transitive verb ‘learned’
The presence of the clause ‘it is a poor plan to overlook any chance’ in the subject position
The presence of the clause ‘that it is a poor plan to overlook any chance’ as the object of the verb ‘learned’
